        # Remove leading "- "
        song_str = line[2:]
        # Split by " by " to get title and artists

    title = song['title']
    artists = song['artists']
    
    # Search for the song
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=spotify_login['access_token'], page_limit=20)
    
    # Find the exact match
    found = False
    for result in results:
        if result['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check if artists match
            result_artists = [a['name'] for a in result['artists']]
            if set(result_artists) == set(artists):
                old_songs_ids.append(result['song_id'])
                found = True
                print(f"Found: {title} -> song_id={result['song_id']}")
                break
    
    if not found:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {title} by {artists}")

for song in old_songs:
    title = song['title']
    artists = song['artists']
    
    # Search for the song
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, access_token=spotify_login['access_token'], page_limit=20)
    
    # Find the exact match
    found = False
    for result in results:
        if result['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check if artists match
            result_artists = [a['name'] for a in result['artists']]
            if set(result_artists) == set(artists):
                old_song_ids.append(result['song_id'])
                found = True
                print(f"Found: {title} -> song_id={result['song_id']}")
                break
    
    if not found:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {title} by {artists}")

print("\nAll old song IDs:", old_song_ids)
